text: CRITICAL lesson (subhuman/krea2 sweep): the strict 32B reviewer was producing FALSE POSITIVES on hands. At full-body 768x1368, hands are ~30px and the VLM guessed 'fused fingers' on 52-100% of stills, driving 3 wasted sweep iterations (v1 15/605, v2 6/528, v3 0/44 darkwolf). Zoom-crop test on 3 'BAD' stills: 32B reports hands anatomically CORRECT (5 fingers, or 4+pinky-obscured). Fix: review rubric now judges GROSS anatomy only + 'prefer GOOD when a tiny detail is unresolvable'. Re-review: darkwolf 44/44 GOOD, envoys 28/33. So the stills were good all along; the metal+scene+weapon fixes were real but the hand panic was a reviewer artifact. Never trust a VLM verdict on sub-50px anatomy without a zoomed crop.

Krea2 character-still pipeline converged: describe_all (metal-ban + no-weapons + simple-bg character-sheet register, weapon sentences stripped post-VLM) -> subhuman_sweep (2-rig 4090/5090 parallel, runtime actor+model catalog verification, no silent lora no-op) -> review_sweep (goldfishbowl 32B, gross-anatomy rubric) -> pick_winners -> h3_scene (FL2VA I2V, portrait 9:16 0.4MP, proven). Keanu Reeves IS on the 4090 (krea2_person_14, catalog was stale during GPU thrash earlier). person_11 is 4090-only. h3_scene portrait fix: T0003 scaffold defaulted 16:9, squished portrait Krea2 stills -> set 9:16/megapixels 0.4/multiple 32 (1.0MP hit latent shape error). 528 v3 stills on disk, review re-running with fixed rubric, expecting high GOOD rate.

T0023 (framing): 9:16 portrait scene still composes clean full-body (head+feet in frame) and matches H3's 9:16 downstream — build_scenes.py now defaults qwen_scene to 768x1368. Finding: the darkwolf WINNER still itself holds a spear, so the weapon propagates into every scene still/H3 shot — the sweep still (desc or LoRA) is reintroducing a weapon despite the describe strip; needs a weapon-free sweep.
